title: Low-Fat, Juicy, Yeasty Mexican Shredded Cheese Tacos
description: Slow-cooked, juicy, and yeasty Mexican tacos featuring shredded cheese, perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of lard or oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced chili peppers and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the cumin, paprika, and salt. Stir for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the shredded Oaxaca cheese and stir until it starts to melt.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the cheese is melted and the mixture is fragrant.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the cheese mixture onto a tortilla and topping with a sprinkle of cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
